passages.text: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said: “Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Topple them on the heads of all the people, and I will kill the rest with the sword. None of those who flee will get away; none of the fugitives will escape.
passages.sermon:
The Lord appeared to me.
He stood beside the altar.
The Lord spoke.
He said, “Strike the tops of the pillars.
Let the thresholds shake.
Let the pillars fall on the heads of all the people.
I will kill the rest with the sword.
No one who tries to run away will escape.
No fugitive will get away.”
passages.original: רָאִ֨יתִי אֶת־ אֲדֹנָ֜י נִצָּ֣ב עַֽל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ הַ֨ךְ הַכַּפְתּ֜וֹר וְיִרְעֲשׁ֣וּ הַסִּפִּ֗ים וּבְצַ֙עַם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖ם בַּחֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא־ יָנ֤וּס לָהֶם֙ נָ֔ס וְלֹֽא־ יִמָּלֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם פָּלִֽיט׃

passages.text: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord is all-powerful.
The Lord sees everything.
If people dig down to Sheol, the place of the dead, the Lord will take them from there.
If people climb up to heaven, the Lord will bring them down from there.
passages.original: אִם־ יַחְתְּר֣וּ בִשְׁא֔וֹל מִשָּׁ֖ם יָדִ֣י תִקָּחֵ֑ם וְאִֽם־ יַעֲלוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִשָּׁ֖ם אוֹרִידֵֽם׃

passages.text: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel, there I will track them and seize them; and though they hide from Me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord is all-seeing and all-powerful.
If people hide themselves on top of Mount Carmel, the Lord will search for them there.
The Lord will find them there.
The Lord will seize them there.
If people hide from the Lord at the bottom of the sea, the Lord will see them there.
The Lord will command the serpent at the bottom of the sea.
The serpent will bite them there.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל מִשָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּלְקַחְתִּ֑ים וְאִם־ יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִנֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַי֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַיָּ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־ הַנָּחָ֖שׁ וּנְשָׁכָֽם׃

passages.text: Though they are driven by their enemies into captivity, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix My eyes upon them for harm and not for good.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks to Israel.
Israel’s enemies may capture them.
Their enemies may take them away as captives.
Even there, the Lord will act.
The Lord will command the sword to kill them.
The Lord will watch them for harm.
He will not watch them for good.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יֵלְכ֤וּ בַשְּׁבִי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיבֵיהֶ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב וַהֲרָגָ֑תַם וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָעָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָֽה׃

passages.text: The Lord GOD of Hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, and all its dwellers mourn— all the land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt— He builds His upper rooms in the heavens and founds His vault upon the earth. He summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth. The LORD is His name.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD of Hosts is the subject.
He is powerful.
He touches the earth.
The earth melts.
All who live on the earth mourn.
The land rises like the Nile.
The land sinks like the river of Egypt.
He builds His upper rooms in the heavens.
He establishes His vault on the earth.
He calls for the waters of the sea.
He pours the waters over the face of the earth.
His name is the LORD.
passages.original: וַאדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה הַצְּבָא֗וֹת הַנּוֹגֵ֤עַ בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ וַתָּמ֔וֹג וְאָבְל֖וּ כָּל־ י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כַיְאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְשָׁקְעָ֖ה כִּיאֹ֥ר מִצְרָֽיִם הַבּוֹנֶ֤ה בַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מַעֲלוֹתוֹ וַאֲגֻדָּת֖וֹ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְסָדָ֑הּ הַקֹּרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־ הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “Are you not like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD. “Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the children of Israel.
The LORD is the God of all nations.
The LORD says, “You are like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel.”
The LORD brought Israel up from the land of Egypt.
The LORD brought the Philistines from Caphtor.
The LORD brought the Arameans from Kir.
passages.original: הֲל֣וֹא כִבְנֵי֩ כֻשִׁיִּ֨ים אַתֶּ֥ם לִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּפְלִשְׁתִּיִּ֥ים מִכַּפְתּ֖וֹר וַאֲרָ֥ם מִקִּֽיר׃

passages.text: Surely the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD watches the sinful kingdom.
He sees everything it does.
The Lord GOD will destroy this sinful kingdom.
He will remove it from the face of the earth.
But the Lord will not completely destroy the house of Jacob.
The LORD Himself declares this.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֞ה עֵינֵ֣י׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה בַּמַּמְלָכָה֙ הַֽחַטָּאָ֔ה וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֶ֗פֶס כִּ֠י לֹ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֥יד אַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “For surely I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve; but not a pebble will reach the ground.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God is the Lord.
God says, “I will give a command.
I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations.
I will do this like a person sifts grain in a sieve.
No pebble will fall to the ground.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וַהֲנִע֥וֹתִי בְכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנּ֙וֹעַ֙ בַּכְּבָרָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יִפּ֥וֹל צְר֖וֹר אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Disaster will never draw near or confront us.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His people Israel.
Some people among Israel sin.
These sinners say, “Disaster will not come close to us.”
They say, “Trouble will not meet us.”
God says these sinners will die by the sword.
passages.original: בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּתוּ כֹּ֖ל חַטָּאֵ֣י עַמִּ֑י הָאֹמְרִ֗ים לֹֽא־ תַגִּ֧ישׁ וְתַקְדִּ֛ים בַּעֲדֵ֖ינוּ הָרָעָֽה׃

passages.text: “In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old, that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear My name,” declares the LORD, who will do this.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD will restore the fallen tent of David.
The tent of David has fallen.
The LORD will repair its broken places.
The LORD will restore its ruins.
The LORD will rebuild it as it was long ago.
The LORD will do this so that His people may possess the remnant of Edom.
His people will also possess all the nations that bear His name.
The LORD declares this.
The LORD will accomplish it.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אָקִ֛ים אֶת־ סֻכַּ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד הַנֹּפֶ֑לֶת וְגָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־ פִּרְצֵיהֶ֗ן וַהֲרִֽסֹתָיו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּבְנִיתִ֖יהָ כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִֽירְשׁ֜וּ אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֤ית אֱדוֹם֙ וְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה זֹּֽאת׃פ

passages.text: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says, “Behold, days are coming.”
In those days, the plowman will overtake the reaper.
The treader of grapes will overtake the sower of seed.
The mountains will drip with sweet wine.
All the hills will flow with wine.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנִגַּ֤שׁ חוֹרֵשׁ֙ בַּקֹּצֵ֔ר וְדֹרֵ֥ךְ עֲנָבִ֖ים בְּמֹשֵׁ֣ךְ הַזָּ֑רַע וְהִטִּ֤יפוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ עָסִ֔יס וְכָל־ הַגְּבָע֖וֹת תִּתְמוֹגַֽגְנָה׃

passages.text: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will restore His people Israel from captivity.
The people of Israel will rebuild ruined cities.
The people of Israel will live in those cities.
The people of Israel will plant vineyards.
The people of Israel will drink the wine from their vineyards.
The people of Israel will make gardens.
The people of Israel will eat the fruit from their gardens.
passages.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֮ אֶת־ שְׁב֣וּת עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וּבָנ֞וּ עָרִ֤ים נְשַׁמּוֹת֙ וְיָשָׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְשָׁת֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־ פְּרִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will firmly plant them in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land that I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD says, “I will plant My people Israel in their own land.
I have given this land to them.
They will never be uprooted from this land again.
I, the LORD your God, have said this.”
passages.original: וּנְטַעְתִּ֖ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֨א יִנָּתְשׁ֜וּ ע֗וֹד מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
